text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, look at your feet, Trainer.
A passing plasterer made it for me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: As you can see—it's a "Royal Castle"!

A magnificent sandcastle
had been completed on the beach.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Looks just like a diorama base, doesn't it?
The name of this royal castle is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, the "Twinkle Series."
And right now, standing atop that citadel is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —She is a queen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In order for me to become ruler,
I must have an audience with the queen, gain her approval, and...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, you must surpass her.
You know who that queen is... don't you?

"The horse girl said to be the strongest in the Senior class right now.
Her name is—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for helping with the spring cleaning.
I can't believe so many of you showed up...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No, if it's for Buena-chan, I'd gladly do it!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So that's—the Queen, Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes—a Double Tiara Umamusume.
She went on to achieve great success in GⅠ races,
even finishing 2nd in an international GⅠ in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Her achievements are certainly impressive... but what is equally wonderful is her character.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Pure, innocent, and cheerful...
She's someone everyone looks up to.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen, Buena Vista"... Come to think of it,
a passing digital gamer
mentioned that before.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Like a main heroine in a galgame
that demands absurdly high stats to conquer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Eh... Gal... ge?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, if she's a rival to all of us,
we need to get to know her much better.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Buena. If you'd like—
would you care to play a board game with us now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A board game! That sounds fun...!
I haven't really played many before, though...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Rest assured.
Let's make it something we can play like a party game."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Within that—I'll find out.
Just what kind of Umamusume she really is.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Since we're doing this, let's pick an ocean-themed board game.
Among the ones I have on hand right now—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I'm playing with a beginner,
which one would you recommend?

There are two kinds of board games.
The one likely to liven things up is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The naval combat game 'Warship', huh?
It really is perfect for beginners."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Well then—let the battle begin!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Warship." The rules are simple.
Fire your cannons at coordinates where you think the enemy is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The winner is the first one to successfully
land their hits and sink 5 ships.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, fire, Admiral Buena.
What waters are you aiming for—where is it!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Prepare the cannons!
Target—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Goal... Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I... cannot shoot.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat? Why?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because doing something like that would be cruel. The people on the other ship have families waiting for them, too...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's just a game! A game, I tell you.
If you're going to say things like that, it takes all the fun out of playing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fire, shoot your shot, Buena...!
Fireeeeee!!

Rulership tried desperately to rally everyone.
What was supposed to be mere play turned into an unusually intense match.
Buena Vista showed a cute side of herself during the board game, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The settlement game "Catan: Seafarers," huh?
Negotiation skills are crucial in this one.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Players can trade resources with each other.
Now then, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I need some lumber.
I'd be happy if I could get around three pieces.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but the only thing I can offer in return
is just one wheat... Wh-What should I do~...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, just one is a bit much, naturally.
I'm not an idiot either.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The world of board games isn't one where real-world popularity carries any weight.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, please take this.
I can't just leave someone who looks so sad alone."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I shall accept.
I have deemed it... an equal trade for your smile.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hah? Hey, you guys――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Here Princess, take these resources as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, why are you letting them win you over?!
Snap out of it!

An overwhelmingly natural charm.
Rulership was forced into a contest that required quite a lot of patience.
Buena Vista showed a cute side of herself during the board game, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, what is thisâ
fluid acceleration...tss?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work.
I'd be thrilled if we could face each other again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: She isn't just fast... It's a smooth, yet powerfully dynamic stride...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Connecting... was out of the question.
She felt like an Umamusume in a realm far above...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is
the stronghold I must conquer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: One day, without fail, I will—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, I—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like everyone's fired up all at once.
Trainer, what's about to begin is truly—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It is a siege conducted by four generals.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yes, standing atop the castle walls, glaring down at the invading army, is Queen Buena Vista. Facing her—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's framed such that the four of us
must somehow conquer it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Of course, only one person can become the next ruler.
This is not a joint struggle, but a competition...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Allies and enemies shift depending on the phase.
Right, Rose, Pisa, Flash Sun?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Why don't we form a temporary alliance this summer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...An alliance? Do you mean
training together?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's what they call the peer effect.
When you share the same goal, it's easier to see growth.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even if we end up outmaneuvering them eventually, wouldn't this be better?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that offer――I shall accept it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd be delighted
to join all of you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Alright, then it's settled.
And so, a temporary alliance for one summer only was forged.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. An alliance is only temporary.
Reaching the fortress first will require a meticulous strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is our strategy meeting for the autumn season.
—It's going to be a long night.
choice_data_list: Yeah, just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.text:
The goal of running the Challenge Cup is set,
but everything else remains a blank slate.
We decided to work out the details.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I intended to take things slow and easy this autumn, but...
I kind of don't want the other folks stealing a march on me either.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Before the Challenge Cup,
I might have to run in a few GI races
and make my move."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The "Tenno Sho (Autumn)" in October, or
the "Japan Cup" in November...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It'll be tough on us physically, but a forced march is our only option.
What do you think?
I think to myself. The immediate goal isn't to "surpass" them, but to run "side-by-side" even for an instant.

If we can establish Rulership as a rival on par with Buena Vista, that would be ideal.
To earn that recognition with minimal resources—
choice_data_list: I don't think there's any need to rush...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Meaning?

We'll wait and see for the autumn.
Until our target, the Challenge Cup, we can just sit back and observe.
And launching the all-out attack is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen? Only that one race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, what matters is the final impression.
Yeah, the final impression is what counts.

text_block_list.text:
Even if you push yourself in GⅠs to hone your edge,
if you lose at the very end, your reputation hits rock bottom.

I felt it made more sense to pour all our strength
into the grand showdown at the end of the year instead.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Haha... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see! That's a great strategy!
Yeah, yeah, even I'm totally satisfied and convinced by this work!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Man... and here I thought I had the upper hand
when it came to drafting plans, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You've really gotten good at this, too.

From someone who looked up from afar, to standing as twin wings.
I can finally act as a worthy partner to Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us bring up the absolute rear.
Once our rivals have worn themselves out and are completely exhausted—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I shall launch an all-out assault.
Let me show you a move from a true tactician.
